package main

import (
	"archive/zip"
	"bytes"
	"os"
	"time"
)

type f struct {
	name string
	mode os.FileMode
	data []byte
}

func main() {
	files := []f{
		{"reviewer/SKILL.md", 0o644, []byte("---\nname: reviewer\ndescription: SKILL-MARKER-reviewer-9f3c21\n---\n\nReview carefully.\n")},
		{"reviewer/references/notes.txt", 0o644, bytes.Repeat([]byte("note \xc3\xa9\n"), 300)},
		{"reviewer/scripts/run.sh", 0o755, []byte("#!/bin/sh\n# SCRIPT-MARKER-reviewer-2b7e40\necho ok\n")},
		{"reviewer/empty.txt", 0o644, nil},
	}
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	zw := zip.NewWriter(&buf)
	for _, e := range files {
		h := &zip.FileHeader{Name: e.name, Method: zip.Deflate, Modified: time.Unix(0, 0).UTC()}
		h.SetMode(e.mode)
		w, _ := zw.CreateHeader(h)
		w.Write(e.data)
	}
	zw.Close()
	os.WriteFile(os.Args[1], buf.Bytes(), 0o644)
}
